notes.title: Demo: Part I Release Date 🌺
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 💖



We’ve got some exciting updates to share! Alongside the reveal of our brand new key art (we’ve been dying to show you this one 🥺), we're thrilled to announce that the first part of the playable demo will be launching this September 2025! 🎉



While we've showcased the demo in local and international events before, this demo will include more gameplay, more CGs, and will feature two out of five love interests 🗡️ You'll be able to uncover the main character's backstory before the story unfolds further in the second part of the demo, which will be announced at a later date!



We can’t wait to hear your thoughts once you get your hands on it! In the meantime, let us know what you think of the new key art in the comments below! We’d love to hear your first impressions 👀 Who caught your eye?



You'll be able to get more updates by joining our Discord server here!



Thank you so much! We're excited to share what we've been working on, please stay tuned! ✨
